title: 新加坡零售商借鉴中国直播电商与AI工具
titleEn: Singapore retailers take inspiration from China's live commerce, AI tools
summary: 新加坡零售商赴杭州考察直播电商和AI驱动的个性化等快速增长的趋势，随后在业务中实施了相关改变。
summaryEn: Singapore retailers visited Hangzhou to study fast-moving trends like live commerce and AI-driven personalisation, and have since implemented changes in their business strategies.
speaker: Ivy Chok
